blocks.prompt: 3 A one-to-one function is defined by \(f(x) = (x - 1)^{3},\ x \in [0, 3]\). Using the concept of reflection in the line \(y = x\), sketch the graph of the inverse function \(f^{-1}(x)\).
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein inverse ka formula nahin, balke reflection ke zariye us ka graph banana hai.
Diya kya hai? \(f(x) = (x - 1)^{3}\), sirf \([0, 3]\) par, aur yeh one-to-one hai.
Find kya karna hai? \(f^{-1}\) ka sketch.
Rule: inverse ka graph f ke graph ka y = x mein aks (reflection) hota hai.
Plan: f ki table, har point ke coordinates ulatna, dono graphs aur y = x ek hi plane par.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = (x - 1)^{3}\), \(x \in [0, 3]\), one-to-one.
Banana: \(f^{-1}\) ka graph, \(f\) ko \(y = x\) mein reflect kar ke.
Tareeqa: \(f\) par point \((a, b)\) ho to \(f^{-1}\) par \((b, a)\) hota hai, jo \((a, b)\) ka \(y = x\) mein aks hai. Is liye har point ko ulat do, graph khud ban jayega.

f ki table
\[f(0) = -1,\quad f(0.5) = -0.125\]
\[f(1) = 0,\quad f(1.5) = 0.125\]
\[f(2) = 1,\quad f(2.5) = 3.375\]
\[f(3) = 8\]
Kyun: misaal ke taur par \(f(2.5) = (1.5)^{3} = 3.375\) aur \(f(0) = (-1)^{3} = -1\). Yeh curve \(y = x^{3}\) ka graph hai jo 1 unit daayen sarak gaya (Section 1.9), is liye \((1, 0)\) par yeh chapta (flat) hota hai.
Dhyan dein: negative number ka cube negative hi rehta hai; (−1)³ = −1, +1 nahin.

Domain aur range
\[D_{f} = [0, 3],\quad R_{f} = [-1, 8]\]
\[D_{f^{-1}} = [-1, 8],\quad R_{f^{-1}} = [0, 3]\]
Kyun: \(f\) barhta hua (increasing) function hai, is liye sab se chhoti value shuru mein \(f(0) = -1\) aur sab se bari aakhir mein \(f(3) = 8\). Inverse domain aur range ki jagah badal deta hai.

Points ko ulatein
\[(0, -1) \to (-1, 0)\]
\[(1, 0) \to (0, 1)\]
\[(2, 1) \to (1, 2)\]
\[(2.5, 3.375) \to (3.375, 2.5)\]
\[(3, 8) \to (8, 3)\]
Kyun: coordinates ki jagah badalna hi point ko y = x mein reflect karna hai.

Sketch
\(y = x\) kheenchiye, \(f\) ka curve \((0, -1)\) se \((3, 8)\) tak, aur ulte points se guzarta smooth curve \((-1, 0)\) se \((8, 3)\) tak. \(f\) ka chapta point \((1, 0)\) inverse par khara (bilkul seedha oopar) point \((0, 1)\) ban jata hai.
Kyun: aaine mein letti hui (horizontal) cheez khari (vertical) nazar aati hai, kyun ke y = x x-axis ko y-axis mein badal deti hai.
Dhyan dein: dono curves ke sire band dots hain, kyun ke domain band interval hai; teer mat lagaiye.

Tasdeeq:
\(y = (x - 1)^{3}\) se \(x = 1 + \sqrt[3]{y}\), is liye \(f^{-1}(x) = 1 + \sqrt[3]{x}\). Ab \(f^{-1}(8) = 1 + 2 = 3\) aur \(f^{-1}(-1) = 1 - 1 = 0\): bilkul wahi sire jo reflection se aaye.
blocks.final_answer: \(f^{-1}\) ka graph \(y = (x - 1)^{3}\), \(0 \le x \le 3\), ka line \(y = x\) mein reflection hai: \((-1, 0)\) se \((0, 1)\) aur \((1, 2)\) ke raste \((8, 3)\) tak curve (is ki equation \(f^{-1}(x) = 1 + \sqrt[3]{x}\), \(-1 \le x \le 8\) hai).

answer_figure.alt: The curve f(x) = (x - 1) cubed from (0, -1) through (1, 0) and (2, 1) to (3, 8), its inverse from (-1, 0) through (0, 1) and (1, 2) to (8, 3), and the line y = x; dashed segments join matching points across y = x.
